findings.text: follow-on: _fully_scored re-derives "every dimension present" from review.scores, a fact the ledger block already carries as review.absent (reckon/crew/review.py:774-786, surfaced at ledger_block); the two are equivalent, so the addition duplicates a derivable fact rather than extending an owner, though the plan's deliverable mandates the scores-based predicate.

follow-on: review_dimensions_median is built with median(dimensions.get(name) or []), which would raise StatisticsError on an empty list; unreachable today because reviewed>0 implies every list is non-empty, but the guard the negative control exercises is an implicit invariant rather than an assertion.
